notes: Paperless 3.3 requires PAPERLESS_DBENGINE=postgresql explicitly; DBHOST alone now leaves the default SQLite engine selected.
The documented DBNAME and DBUSER defaults are paperless, matching the dedicated PostgreSQL database and user.
Only the webserver publishes a loopback port. PostgreSQL and Redis remain on the project's private network with separate named volumes.
PAPERLESS_ADMIN_USER and PAPERLESS_ADMIN_PASSWORD create the administrator at first boot without changing an existing user's password. Only the administrator login is shown in the first-run card.
The 3.3 stable minor tag was verified on Docker Hub for RC-09. The 1g application floor and all images await live RC-13 verification.
